gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes classifying the loading procedure used for a static axial compressive load test, per ASTM D1143/D1143M's seven named procedures. Used for the value of diggs:StaticLoadTestType/loadingProcedure. Deliberately spans more than one governing standard: EN ISO 22477-1 (the current European static pile load test standard, and the one ASIRI-governed rigid-inclusion projects most often cite) covers only the maintained-load family and explicitly excludes constant-rate-of-penetration and cyclic testing, so maintained_load is the value both traditions share and the one an EN ISO 22477-1 test always states; the other six entries are ASTM-specific options with no EN ISO 22477-1 equivalent. Cite the governing standard itself through the test procedure's own testProcedureMethod property, not through this value.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Static Load Test Procedure Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Load applied in equal increments at a fixed short time interval, regardless of the rate of movement, to the maximum test load. ASTM D1143/D1143M Procedure A - the default procedure where none other is specified.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Quick Test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Load held at each increment until the rate of movement has stabilized to a specified criterion, or for a specified minimum time, before advancing to the next increment. ASTM D1143/D1143M Procedure B (Maintained Test); the sole method covered by EN ISO 22477-1, whose own stabilization criterion serves the same purpose. The method most RI projects governed by ASIRI or EN ISO 22477-1 will use.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Maintained Load Test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The Maintained Load Test procedure carried beyond the standard maximum test load, to a load specified by the engineer. ASTM D1143/D1143M Procedure C.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Loading in Excess of Standard Test Load

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Load applied in increments each held for a fixed, engineer-specified time interval regardless of the rate of movement. ASTM D1143/D1143M Procedure D.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Constant Time Interval Test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Load increased continuously so the test element moves at a constant, specified rate of penetration; the load is whatever the ground offers at that rate. ASTM D1143/D1143M Procedure E. Not covered by EN ISO 22477-1, which excludes constant-rate-of-penetration testing from its scope.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Constant Rate of Penetration Test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Load adjusted so the test element advances in equal, specified movement increments, the load at each increment being read once movement has stabilized. ASTM D1143/D1143M Procedure F.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Constant Movement Increment Test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The test element loaded and unloaded through repeated cycles to a series of increasing maximum loads. ASTM D1143/D1143M Procedure G. Not covered by EN ISO 22477-1, which excludes cyclic load testing from its scope.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Cyclic Loading Test
